en_us: Seven aircraft from a handful of parts: airships, biplanes, a copter you pedal; engines, upgrades, weapons and fuel.
es_es: Siete aeronaves con un puñado de piezas: dirigibles, biplanos, un helicóptero a pulmón; motores, mejoras, armas y combustible.

hover.en_us: Back to the Sun of Heliodor

text.en_us: built in the hangar, one part at a time
text.es_es: armado en el hangar, pieza por pieza

en_us.title: Hulls
en_us.subtitle: Logs and iron. The flying comes later.
text: [lead] The [item:immersive_aircraft:hull|Hull] is the frame of almost every aircraft.
[li] Six logs and three iron ingots.
[li] Airship [hl|2], biplane [hl|3], warship [hl|3] more.
[li] Everything here is crafted on a crafting table.

es_es.title: Cascos
es_es.subtitle: Troncos y hierro. El vuelo viene después.
text: [lead] El [item:immersive_aircraft:hull|Casco] es el armazón de casi todas las aeronaves.
[li] Seis troncos y tres lingotes de hierro.
[li] Dirigible [hl|2], biplano [hl|3], buque de guerra [hl|3] más.
[li] Todo se fabrica en la mesa de trabajo.

sources: repo:docs/design/aircraft-balance.md#27 crafting shaped recipes, no workstation

en_us.title: Canvas
text: [lead] [item:immersive_aircraft:sail|Sails] are the airship's envelope: it wants [hl|6].
[li] Six white carpets and three string.
[li:immersive_aircraft:propeller] Planes fly on a [item:immersive_aircraft:propeller|Propeller]: five iron ingots bent into shape.

es_es.title: Lona
text: [lead] Las [item:immersive_aircraft:sail|Velas] son la envoltura del dirigible: pide [hl|6].
[li] Seis alfombras blancas y tres hilos.
[li:immersive_aircraft:propeller] Los aviones vuelan con un [item:immersive_aircraft:propeller|Propulsor]: cinco lingotes de hierro doblados.

en_us.title: A copper heart
text: [lead] The [item:immersive_aircraft:boiler|Boiler] goes into every Engine.
[li] Seven copper ingots around a furnace.
[li] In flight, the fuel slot is the boiler: it burns what a furnace burns.

es_es.title: Un corazón de cobre
text: [lead] La [item:immersive_aircraft:boiler|Caldera] va adentro de cada Motor.
[li] Siete lingotes de cobre alrededor de un horno.
[li] En vuelo, la ranura de combustible es la caldera: quema lo mismo que un horno.

en_us.title: The engine room
en_us.subtitle: One regulator, seven aircraft.
text: [lead] The [item:immersive_aircraft:engine|Engine] drives the airship, the biplane and the quadrocopter.
[li] A Boiler, two pistons, a blast furnace and cobblestone.
[note] In this pack a [item:entrelumen:power_regulator|Power Regulator] from act III takes the top stone.
{page}
The warship takes two, and the bamboo hopper one more on top of its biplanes.
The gyrodyne needs none.

es_es.title: La sala de máquinas
es_es.subtitle: Un regulador, siete aeronaves.
text: [lead] El [item:immersive_aircraft:engine|Motor] mueve el dirigible, el biplano y el quadrocóptero.
[li] Una Caldera, dos pistones, un alto horno y roca.
[note] En este pack, un [item:entrelumen:power_regulator|Regulador de energía] del acto III reemplaza la roca de arriba.
{page}
El buque de guerra lleva dos, y la tolva de bambú uno más además de sus biplanos.
El girodino no necesita ninguno.

en_us.title: Slow and forgiving
en_us.subtitle: The best first flight.
text: [lead] The [item:immersive_aircraft:airship|Airship] rises and sinks straight, and hangs still in the air.
[li] Six sails, two hulls and an Engine.
[li] [hl|16] cargo slots, [hl|3] upgrades, a weapon, [hl|2] seats.
{page}
[li] Right-click the ground with the item to set it down.
[li] It needs room to unfold.

es_es.title: Lento y noble
es_es.subtitle: El mejor primer vuelo.
text: [lead] El [item:immersive_aircraft:airship|Dirigible] sube y baja derecho, y se queda quieto en el aire.
[li] Seis velas, dos cascos y un Motor.
[li] [hl|16] ranuras de carga, [hl|3] mejoras, un arma y [hl|2] asientos.
{page}
[li] Hacé clic derecho al suelo con el ítem para apoyarlo.
[li] Necesita lugar para armarse.

en_us.title: Moving day
text: [lead] The [item:immersive_aircraft:cargo_airship|Cargo Airship] carries a whole storage room.
[li] An Airship, four chests and a hull.
[li] Four side crates add [hl|64] slots: [hl|80] in all.
[li] No weapon, [hl|4] upgrades, and [hl|25%] more fuel.

es_es.title: Día de mudanza
text: [lead] El [item:immersive_aircraft:cargo_airship|Dirigible de carga] lleva un depósito entero.
[li] Un Dirigible, cuatro cofres y un casco.
[li] Cuatro cajones laterales suman [hl|64] ranuras: [hl|80] en total.
[li] Sin arma, [hl|4] mejoras y un [hl|25%] más de combustible.

en_us.title: Flying fortress
en_us.subtitle: Three boilers, zero subtlety.
text: [lead] The [item:immersive_aircraft:warship|Warship] is the biggest thing in the sky.
[li] A Cargo Airship, two engines, three hulls, two sails and industrial gears.
[li] [hl|3×] durability, [hl|6] upgrades, [hl|66] cargo slots, [hl|4] seats.
[li] One weapon slot arms [hl|4] side mounts, the other [hl|2] in front.
{page}
Feed all three boilers: it only runs at full power when every one burns.
Fit a gyroscope and a hull reinforcement before you go looking for trouble.

es_es.title: Fortaleza voladora
es_es.subtitle: Tres calderas, cero disimulo.
text: [lead] El [item:immersive_aircraft:warship|Buque de guerra] es lo más grande que vuela.
[li] Un Dirigible de carga, dos motores, tres cascos, dos velas y engranajes industriales.
[li] Durabilidad [hl|3×], [hl|6] mejoras, [hl|66] ranuras de carga, [hl|4] asientos.
[li] Una ranura de armas arma [hl|4] montajes laterales; la otra, [hl|2] al frente.
{page}
Alimentá las tres calderas: sólo rinde al máximo cuando arden todas.
Ponele un giroscopio y un refuerzo de casco antes de salir a buscar lío.

sources: jar:immersive_aircraft-1.5.2+1.21.1-neoforge.jar:immersive_aircraft/entity/InventoryVehicleEntity.class#one weapon per mount of its slot

en_us.title: Needs a runway
en_us.subtitle: Fast, loud and in a hurry.
text: [lead] The [item:immersive_aircraft:biplane|Biplane] is the fast one.
[li] Three hulls, an Engine and a Propeller.
[li] Taxi on flat ground until it's fast, then pull back to climb.
[li] Land the same way: long, flat and slow.
{page}
[hl|4] upgrades, a weapon, a rocket slot, [hl|16] cargo slots and [hl|1] seat.
It burns [hl|25%] more fuel than the airship.

es_es.title: Necesita pista
es_es.subtitle: Rápido, ruidoso y apurado.
text: [lead] El [item:immersive_aircraft:biplane|Biplano] es el rápido.
[li] Tres cascos, un Motor y un Propulsor.
[li] Carretealo en terreno plano hasta tomar velocidad y tirá hacia atrás para subir.
[li] Para aterrizar, lo mismo: largo, plano y despacio.
{page}
[hl|4] mejoras, un arma, una ranura de cohetes, [hl|16] ranuras de carga y [hl|1] asiento.
Gasta un [hl|25%] más de combustible que el dirigible.

sources: jar:immersive_aircraft-1.5.2+1.21.1-neoforge.jar:immersive_aircraft/entity/AirplaneEntity.class#push speed on ground, pitch by pull

en_us.title: Seaplane
en_us.subtitle: The game says Bamboo Hopper. It's a seaplane.
text: [lead] The [item:immersive_aircraft:bamboo_hopper|Bamboo Hopper] lands on water: it has pontoons.
[li] Two Biplanes, a hull, an Engine and five bamboo blocks.
[li] [hl|3] seats, [hl|2] weapon slots, [hl|4] upgrades and a rocket slot.
[li] [hl|50%] more fuel than the airship.

es_es.title: Hidroavión
es_es.subtitle: El juego le dice «Tolva de bambú». Es un hidroavión.
text: [lead] La [item:immersive_aircraft:bamboo_hopper|Tolva de bambú] aterriza en el agua: tiene flotadores.
[li] Dos Biplanos, un casco, un Motor y cinco bloques de bambú.
[li] [hl|3] asientos, [hl|2] ranuras de armas, [hl|4] mejoras y una ranura de cohetes.
[li] Un [hl|50%] más de combustible que el dirigible.

en_us.title: Rocket boost
text: [lead] [item:minecraft:firework_rocket|Firework Rockets] give a push in flight.
[li] They go in the rocket slot of the biplane, the bamboo hopper and the warship.
[li] [key:key.immersive_aircraft.boost] burns one for a push forward.
[li] Longer-flight rockets push for longer.

es_es.title: Empujón de cohete
text: [lead] Los [item:minecraft:firework_rocket|Cohetes de fuegos artificiales] dan un empujón en vuelo.
[li] Van en la ranura de cohetes del biplano, la tolva de bambú y el buque de guerra.
[li] [key:key.immersive_aircraft.boost] quema uno para empujarte hacia adelante.
[li] Los cohetes de más vuelo empujan más tiempo.

sources: jar:immersive_aircraft-1.5.2+1.21.1-neoforge.jar:immersive_aircraft/entity/InventoryVehicleEntity.class#boost: flight duration x 50 ticks, one rocket per slot

en_us.title: Pedal power
en_us.subtitle: Leg day, airborne.
text: [lead] No engine: the [item:immersive_aircraft:gyrodyne|Gyrodyne] flies on your hunger.
[li] Hold [key:key.forward] on the ground until the rotor reaches takeoff speed.
[li] Eat before a trip: with too little food it won't fly.
{page}
[note] In this pack a [item:mekanism:alloy_reinforced|Reinforced Alloy] from act III takes the lower sail's place.

es_es.title: A pulmón
es_es.subtitle: Día de piernas, en el aire.
text: [lead] Sin motor: el [item:immersive_aircraft:gyrodyne|Girodino] vuela con tu hambre.
[li] Mantené [key:key.forward] en el suelo hasta que el rotor llegue a la velocidad de despegue.
[li] Comé antes de salir: con poca comida no despega.
{page}
[note] En este pack, una [item:mekanism:alloy_reinforced|Aleación reforzada] del acto III reemplaza la vela de abajo.

sources: repo:pack/kubejs/server_scripts/entrelumen_aircraft_balance.js#immersive_aircraft:gyrodyne: reinforced alloy for the lower sail

en_us.title: Builder's drone
en_us.subtitle: Four rotors and some bamboo.
text: [lead] The [item:immersive_aircraft:quadrocopter|Quadrocopter] hovers still and barely feels the wind.
[li] Four propellers, four bamboo and an Engine.
[li] Half an airship's fuel: made for building up high.
[li] [hl|6] cargo slots, [hl|1] upgrade, a weapon.

es_es.title: El dron del albañil
es_es.subtitle: Cuatro hélices y unas cañas.
text: [lead] El [item:immersive_aircraft:quadrocopter|Quadrocóptero] se queda quieto y casi no siente el viento.
[li] Cuatro propulsores, cuatro bambúes y un Motor.
[li] Gasta la mitad que un dirigible: está hecho para construir en altura.
[li] [hl|6] ranuras de carga, [hl|1] mejora y un arma.

en_us.title: More power
text: [lead] Upgrade slots take parts that change the numbers.
[li:immersive_aircraft:sturdy_pipes] [item:immersive_aircraft:sturdy_pipes|Sturdy Pipes]: [good|+10%] power.
[li:immersive_aircraft:steel_boiler] [item:immersive_aircraft:steel_boiler|Steel Boiler]: [good|+25%] power, [warn|+50%] fuel.
[li:immersive_aircraft:nether_engine] [item:immersive_aircraft:nether_engine|Nether Engine]: [good|+40%] power, [warn|+30%] fuel.
{page}
The Nether Engine costs a netherite ingot. Each upgrade's tooltip lists its numbers.

es_es.title: Más potencia
text: [lead] Las ranuras de mejora aceptan piezas que cambian los números.
[li:immersive_aircraft:sturdy_pipes] [item:immersive_aircraft:sturdy_pipes|Tuberías resistentes]: [good|+10%] de potencia.
[li:immersive_aircraft:steel_boiler] [item:immersive_aircraft:steel_boiler|Caldera de acero]: [good|+25%] de potencia, [warn|+50%] de combustible.
[li:immersive_aircraft:nether_engine] [item:immersive_aircraft:nether_engine|Motor de Nether]: [good|+40%] de potencia, [warn|+30%] de combustible.
{page}
El Motor de Nether cuesta un lingote de netherita. El tooltip de cada mejora muestra sus números.

en_us.title: Less fuel
text: [lead] Two parts stretch every load of fuel.
[li:immersive_aircraft:industrial_gears] [item:immersive_aircraft:industrial_gears|Industrial Gears]: [good|-20%] fuel.
[li:immersive_aircraft:eco_engine] [item:immersive_aircraft:eco_engine|Eco Engine]: [good|-75%] fuel, [warn|-20%] power.
{page}
The gears also go into the Warship and the Rotary Cannon.

es_es.title: Menos combustible
text: [lead] Dos piezas estiran cada carga de combustible.
[li:immersive_aircraft:industrial_gears] [item:immersive_aircraft:industrial_gears|Engranajes industriales]: [good|-20%] de combustible.
[li:immersive_aircraft:eco_engine] [item:immersive_aircraft:eco_engine|Motor ecológico]: [good|-75%] de combustible, [warn|-20%] de potencia.
{page}
Los engranajes también van en el Buque de guerra y en el Cañón giratorio.

en_us.title: Steady in the wind
text: [lead] Wind shoves aircraft around, [hl|3×] harder in rain and storms.
[li:immersive_aircraft:gyroscope] A [item:immersive_aircraft:gyroscope|Gyroscope] cancels the wind and steadies the nose.
[li:immersive_aircraft:gyroscope_dials] The [item:immersive_aircraft:gyroscope_dials|Advanced Gyroscope] adds a dial dashboard.
[li:immersive_aircraft:gyroscope_hud] The [item:immersive_aircraft:gyroscope_hud|Electronic Gyroscope] adds a HUD.

es_es.title: Firme con viento
text: [lead] El viento empuja las aeronaves, [hl|3×] más con lluvia y tormenta.
[li:immersive_aircraft:gyroscope] Un [item:immersive_aircraft:gyroscope|Giroscopio] anula el viento y estabiliza la nariz.
[li:immersive_aircraft:gyroscope_dials] El [item:immersive_aircraft:gyroscope_dials|Gyroscopio avanzado] suma un tablero de relojes.
[li:immersive_aircraft:gyroscope_hud] El [item:immersive_aircraft:gyroscope_hud|Gyroscopio electrónico] suma un HUD.

en_us.title: Tougher, quicker
text: [lead] Three parts work on the frame.
[li:immersive_aircraft:hull_reinforcement] [item:immersive_aircraft:hull_reinforcement|Hull Reinforcement]: [good|+100%] durability.
[li:immersive_aircraft:improved_landing_gear] [item:immersive_aircraft:improved_landing_gear|Improved Landing Gear]: [good|+50%] takeoff speed.
[li:immersive_aircraft:enhanced_propeller] [item:immersive_aircraft:enhanced_propeller|Enhanced Propeller]: [good|-75%] air friction.

es_es.title: Más duro, más ágil
text: [lead] Tres piezas trabajan sobre el armazón.
[li:immersive_aircraft:hull_reinforcement] [item:immersive_aircraft:hull_reinforcement|Refuerzo del casco]: [good|+100%] de durabilidad.
[li:immersive_aircraft:improved_landing_gear] [item:immersive_aircraft:improved_landing_gear|Tren de aterrizaje mejorado]: [good|+50%] de velocidad de despegue.
[li:immersive_aircraft:enhanced_propeller] [item:immersive_aircraft:enhanced_propeller|Hélice mejorada]: [good|-75%] de rozamiento con el aire.

en_us.title: Armament
text: [lead] A weapon slot takes one of four, fired with [key:key.use].
[li:immersive_aircraft:rotary_cannon] [item:immersive_aircraft:rotary_cannon|Rotary Cannon]: a gunpowder, [hl|10] shots.
[li:immersive_aircraft:heavy_crossbow] [item:immersive_aircraft:heavy_crossbow|Heavy Crossbow]: an arrow, [hl|2] bolts.
[li:immersive_aircraft:bomb_bay] [item:immersive_aircraft:bomb_bay|Bomb Bay]: a TNT, [hl|5] bombs.
[li:immersive_aircraft:telescope] [item:immersive_aircraft:telescope|Telescope]: a spyglass that rides along.
{page}
Ammo comes from the aircraft's own cargo, and by default no weapon breaks blocks.

es_es.title: Armamento
text: [lead] Una ranura de armas acepta una de cuatro, que se dispara con [key:key.use].
[li:immersive_aircraft:rotary_cannon] [item:immersive_aircraft:rotary_cannon|Cañón giratorio]: una pólvora, [hl|10] disparos.
[li:immersive_aircraft:heavy_crossbow] [item:immersive_aircraft:heavy_crossbow|Ballesta pesada]: una flecha, [hl|2] virotes.
[li:immersive_aircraft:bomb_bay] [item:immersive_aircraft:bomb_bay|Bahía de bombas]: una dinamita, [hl|5] bombas.
[li:immersive_aircraft:telescope] [item:immersive_aircraft:telescope|Telescopio]: un catalejo que viaja con vos.
{page}
La munición sale de la carga de la propia aeronave, y por defecto ningún arma rompe bloques.

en_us.title: Colours and flags
text: [lead] Airships, cargo airships and biplanes fly a banner from their banner slot.
[li] Airships, cargo airships and warships take a dye in their dye slot.
[li] Painted or not, it flies the same.

es_es.title: Colores y banderas
text: [lead] Dirigibles, dirigibles de carga y biplanos llevan un estandarte en su ranura de estandarte.
[li] Dirigibles, dirigibles de carga y buques de guerra aceptan un tinte en su ranura de tinte.
[li] Con pintura o sin ella, vuela igual.

en_us.title: Stick and throttle
text: [tip] Flying uses your movement keys.
[li] [key:key.forward] / [key:key.back]: nose down or up; on airships, ahead or back.
[li] [key:key.jump] / [key:key.sneak]: throttle on planes; climb or sink on airships.
[li] [key:key.left] / [key:key.right]: turn.
{page}
[key:key.immersive_aircraft.dismount] gets you out; in the air, press it twice to jump.
Inside, the camera switches to third person by default.

es_es.title: Palanca y acelerador
text: [tip] Se vuela con las teclas de caminar.
[li] [key:key.forward] / [key:key.back]: nariz abajo o arriba; en dirigibles, avanzar o retroceder.
[li] [key:key.jump] / [key:key.sneak]: acelerador en aviones; subir o bajar en dirigibles.
[li] [key:key.left] / [key:key.right]: girar.
{page}
[key:key.immersive_aircraft.dismount] te baja; en el aire, apretala dos veces para saltar.
Adentro, la cámara pasa a tercera persona por defecto.

sources: jar:immersive_aircraft-1.5.2+1.21.1-neoforge.jar:immersive_aircraft/client/KeyBindings.class#on NeoForge the fallback keys use the vanilla movement keys
jar:immersive_aircraft-1.5.2+1.21.1-neoforge.jar:immersive_aircraft/entity/AirplaneEntity.class#movementY sets the engine target; pitch from forward/back
jar:immersive_aircraft-1.5.2+1.21.1-neoforge.jar:immersive_aircraft/entity/VehicleEntity.class#dismount twice within 20 ticks in the air

en_us.title: What the boiler eats
text: [tip] Anything a furnace burns is fuel, and [item:minecraft:blaze_powder|Blaze Powder] too.
[li] The gauge over the hotbar shows the engine.
[li] Running low cuts power and brings a warning; with none, the engine stops.
{page}
Fuel use by aircraft:
[li] Quadrocopter [hl|×0.5], warship [hl|×0.8].
[li] Airship [hl|×1]; biplane and cargo airship [hl|×1.25].
[li] Bamboo hopper [hl|×1.5].

es_es.title: Lo que come la caldera
text: [tip] Todo lo que quema un horno es combustible, y el [item:minecraft:blaze_powder|Polvo de blaze] también.
[li] El indicador sobre la barra rápida muestra el motor.
[li] Con poco combustible baja la potencia y llega un aviso; sin nada, el motor se apaga.
{page}
Consumo por aeronave:
[li] Quadrocóptero [hl|×0,5], buque de guerra [hl|×0,8].
[li] Dirigible [hl|×1]; biplano y dirigible de carga [hl|×1,25].
[li] Tolva de bambú [hl|×1,5].

en_us.title: Patch it before you fly
text: [tip] A damaged aircraft won't let you in: right-clicks patch it first.
[li] Each click repairs a little and makes you hungry.
[li] Crashes explode without breaking blocks or starting fires, and they can't kill you.
{page}
[li] Break an aircraft and it comes back as an item with its upgrades inside.
[li] Its cargo drops.

es_es.title: Emparchá antes de volar
text: [tip] Una aeronave dañada no te deja subir: los clics derechos primero la emparchan.
[li] Cada clic repara un poco y te da hambre.
[li] Los choques explotan sin romper bloques ni prender fuego, y no te pueden matar.
{page}
[li] Si la rompés, vuelve como ítem con sus mejoras adentro.
[li] La carga cae al piso.

sources: jar:immersive_aircraft-1.5.2+1.21.1-neoforge.jar:immersive_aircraft/config/Config.class#enableCrashExplosion true, enableCrashBlockDestruction false, enableCrashFire false, preventKillThroughCrash true

en_us.title: Air taxi
en_us.subtitle: Mind the villager.
text: [tip] Mobs climb aboard as they would into a boat; water animals don't.
[li] Seats: airship and gyrodyne [hl|2], bamboo hopper [hl|3], warship [hl|4].
[li] Other players board with a right-click.

es_es.title: Remís aéreo
es_es.subtitle: Ojo con el aldeano.
text: [tip] Los mobs se suben como a un bote; los animales acuáticos, no.
[li] Asientos: dirigible y girodino [hl|2], tolva de bambú [hl|3], buque de guerra [hl|4].
[li] Los demás jugadores suben con clic derecho.

en_us.title: Hard landing
en_us.subtitle: Any landing you walk away from counts.
text: [lead] Your first wreck, on the record: your statistics count every crash.
[li] Here crashes break no blocks and can't kill you.

es_es.title: Aterrizaje forzoso
es_es.subtitle: Si salís caminando, cuenta como aterrizaje.
text: [lead] Tu primer choque, registrado: tus estadísticas cuentan cada accidente.
[li] Acá los choques no rompen bloques ni te pueden matar.

en_us.title: Frequent flyer
en_us.subtitle: Ten thousand blocks of sky.
text: [lead] [hl|10 km] flown at the controls: your statistics keep every metre.
[li] Time aboard and fuel burned are counted too.

es_es.title: Viajero frecuente
es_es.subtitle: Diez mil bloques de cielo.
text: [lead] [hl|10 km] volados a los mandos: tus estadísticas guardan cada metro.
[li] También cuentan el tiempo a bordo y el combustible quemado.

sources: jar:immersive_aircraft-1.5.2+1.21.1-neoforge.jar:immersive_aircraft/entity/VehicleEntity.class#pilot gets speed x 100 cm per tick

en_us.title: Spare hulls
en_us.subtitle: The hangar always wants more.
text: [lead] Four [item:immersive_aircraft:hull|Hulls] for the common store, once a day.
[li] Six logs and three iron each.

es_es.title: Cascos de repuesto
es_es.subtitle: El hangar siempre pide más.
text: [lead] Cuatro [item:immersive_aircraft:hull|Cascos] para el depósito común, una vez por día.
[li] Seis troncos y tres de hierro cada uno.

en_us.title: Switch on the floodlights
en_us.subtitle: Night shift starts now.
text: [lead] A hangar looks better with the big lights on.
No reward: four cones of light down to the floor.

es_es.title: Prendé los reflectores
es_es.subtitle: Arranca el turno noche.
text: [lead] Un hangar luce mejor con las luces grandes prendidas.
Sin premio: cuatro conos de luz hasta el piso.

en_us.title: Light a flare
en_us.subtitle: Somebody has to test the sky.
text: [lead] One rocket, straight up, for nobody in particular.
No reward: colours over the hangar roof.

es_es.title: Prendé una bengala
es_es.subtitle: Alguien tiene que probar el cielo.
text: [lead] Un cohete, derecho al cielo, para nadie en particular.
Sin premio: colores sobre el techo del hangar.
